args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the docstring (and FIN-212, and `tests/test_money.py`) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly test failure on `2.665` → expected `2.66`, got `2.67`.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: passed (includes `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).
